text:
B is better. It is the only one that meets the "under 120 words" limit, at roughly 116 words by my count. Response A runs to about 220 words, nearly double the limit. A also opens with filler ("Thank you for reviewing this summary…"), which wastes a busy manager's time.

B also keeps the key points: the term, cost, allowance, overage rates, the colour-overage risk, the early-exit penalty and the end-of-term options. It drops only the contact name.
